component.name: Nuage
component.summary: Your cloud storage as a regular folder

description.p: Nuage shows your cloud storage accounts as folders of your home, like any other folder: files open in your usual applications and are downloaded only when you use them. Changes are uploaded in the background.

ul.li: Set up an account in a few screens, signed in through your browser or with a password
See what is syncing, pause and resume uploads
Browse, upload, move and share files, even when an account is not mounted
Keep folders or patterns out of the sync
Keep files and folders available offline
Google Docs open in your web browser

description.p: Nuage uses rclone. Google Drive, OneDrive, Nextcloud, WebDAV and S3 bucket storage are supported, and Dropbox and pCloud in preview; for Google Drive, your own sign-in client keeps your access private to you.

screenshot.caption: Browse your files, even when the account is not mounted
Your accounts, their state and space
A guided setup, in a few screens

ul.li: Install on the desktop from Nuage's own Flatpak repository (flatpak install --user https://felixilgatto.github.io/nuage/nuage.flatpakref): Nuage then updates with flatpak update and in Software. The .flatpak bundles of the releases update from it too.
Packages for ARM64 (Raspberry Pi, ARM servers) besides x86-64, and an .rpm for Fedora and openSUSE besides the .deb and the tarball.
Each download comes with a checksum and a build provenance: gh attestation verify <file> --repo felixilgatto/nuage proves it was built by the release workflow.
New providers: Nextcloud and WebDAV (server address and password), and S3 bucket storage (Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO…, with an access key; one bucket, or all of them).
In preview, not yet tried with real accounts: Dropbox and pCloud (sign in in the browser), and Proton Drive as a build option.

Nuage checks the connection before adding an account set up with a form (Nextcloud, WebDAV, S3, Proton Drive): a wrong password or bucket is reported at once, with what to check, instead of giving a folder that shows nothing.

Folders mount after a restart even when the keyring is slow to answer at login (a session that logs in automatically, or a desktop portal still starting): Nuage waits for it instead of stopping. Meanwhile, the tray shows "Waiting for the keyring" with a key, not a problem; it becomes a problem after 3 minutes. The window starts the Nuage service again if it crashes.
Removing an account no longer fills the log with errors about its cache.
After an update installed while Nuage runs, folders still mount, and Nuage offers to restart into the new version.
Leaving the folder screen without starting the sync no longer leaves a half-added account; going back is locked while the folder is set up.
After adding an account, the window stays open on the accounts list, with "Open Folder"; "Start Sync" shows that it is working.
How to uninstall, in the README.

OneDrive (personal): sign in in the browser, no client to create. Nuage picks your own drive (the one named "OneDrive"), and the next one if Microsoft refuses it; on a server, --token-file works the same way. The Personal Vault, which cannot be opened, is documented.
Google shared drives, each as an account of its own, added from a Google account without signing in again.

Offline mode: keep files and folders on this computer ("Keep Offline" in the browser, nuage pin). They open and can be edited without a connection, also after a restart; changes upload when it comes back, and a file changed in two places keeps both versions.
A warning when the items kept offline take more than a chosen space (offline-warning).
Offline, the other items stay listed and fail to open at once, without blocking file managers.
After signing in, the browser shows a Nuage page and Nuage comes back to the front.

description.p: First version: Google Drive and local folders, mounted with rclone.
